name: Lunch-Break HIIT 30
desc: Thirty minutes that count: 8 x 30 seconds hard at 120% FTP with 90 seconds easy spinning. Short, time-efficient intervals raise fitness and calorie burn without long hours. Spin a light gear at 95+ rpm on the hard parts.
src: Short-interval HIIT for time-crunched riders (Gibala-style low-volume HIIT)

name: Lunch-Break HIIT 40
desc: The step up from HIIT 30: 10 x 40 seconds at 115% FTP with 80 seconds easy. Keep each effort smooth and seated; the last three should feel hard but doable.

name: Zone 2 with Tempo Touches
desc: An hour of steady Zone 2 (the fat-burning, conversational pace) with three 6-minute tempo blocks to keep it interesting and lift the energy cost a little. You should be able to talk in short sentences during the tempo parts.

name: Sweet Spot Pyramid 50
desc: 2-3-4-3-2 minutes at 88-92% FTP with 2 minutes easy between: a compact sweet-spot session that builds the engine and burns plenty of energy in under an hour.

name: Intro 4x4 (105%)
desc: A gentle first taste of the classic 4x4: four 4-minute efforts at 105% FTP with 3 minutes easy. Hard breathing by the end of each rep, but controlled. One of the most effective sessions for fitness and metabolic health.

name: Weekend Zone 2 (100 min)
desc: The weekly long ride: 100 minutes of easy Zone 2 with short cadence variations so the time passes. Long, easy rides are where most of the fat-burning adaptations happen. Bring a podcast and a bottle.
